sources.label: Morphe patches to remove ads, analytics, apk junk, debug info, duplicate graphic
sources.author: BlazeFTL
patch_list: Adds a Keyword filter entry to the 3-dot menu to hide posts by title keywords, with long-press hide and copy.
Applies the Material red and purple palette to the Apps and Games tabs.
Adds a Mod settings entry to the 3-dot menu to show or hide sidebar items.
Launches the home screen directly instead of the splash screen.
